Detailed Definition: Growth in capital expenditure (capx) minus average growth in capital expenditure in the same industry (two-digit SIC). If capx is missing, capital expenditure is defined as the annual change in property, plant and equipment (ppent). Capital expenditure growth is defined as the percentage growth of capx today relative to the average capx over the previous two years (.5*(capx$_{t-1}$ + capx$_{t-2}$), or as percentage growth relative to the previous year only if t-2 is missing.
